in_marathi.name: Vl
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vl हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vl is a powerful and strong name. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vira', which means hero. This name is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and courageous individuals. It is also associated with wisdom and the ability to overcome challenges.
